The '''2021–22 Eastern Illinois Panthers men's basketball team''' represented [[Eastern Illinois University]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Panthers, led by first-year head coach [[Marty Simmons]], played their home games at [[Lantz Arena]] in [[Charleston, Illinois]] as members of the [[Ohio Valley Conference]] (OVC). They finished the season 5–26, 3–15 in OVC play, to finish in last place. They failed to qualify for the [[2022 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|OVC tournament]].

==Previous season==
In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Eastern Illinois Panthers men's basketball team|Panthers]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2020–21 season]] 9–18, 6–14 in OVC play, to finish in a tie for ninth place. They failed to qualify for the [[2021 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|OVC tournament]].

On March 4, 2021, the school announced that they would not renew head coach [[Jay Spoonhour]]'s contract.<ref>{{cite web |date=March 4, 2021 |title=Coach Jay Spoonhour's Contract Not Renewed |url=https://eiupanthers.com/news/2021/3/4/mens-basketball-coach-jay-spoonhours-contract-not-renewed.aspx |access-date=October 30, 2021 |work=Big Sky Conference |language=en}}</ref> On March 31, the school named [[Clemson Tigers men's basketball|Clemson]] assistant and former [[Evansville Purple Aces men's basketball|Evansville]] head coach Marty Simmons as the team's new head coach.<ref>{{cite web |last=Pontbriand |first=Alessandra |date=April 2, 2021 |title=Eastern Illinois hires Marty Simmons as new men's basketball head coach |url=https://newschannel20.com/sports/content/eastern-illinois-hires-marty-simmons-as-new-mens-basketball-head-coach |access-date=October 30, 2021 |work=WICS |language=en}}</ref>
